headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 2, 2026**
article:
The Orioles continued their winning streak with a 6-1 victory over the White Sox, while the Guardians dominated the Rangers 9-4. The Nationals routed the Red Sox 10-2, and the Tigers took down the Yankees 6-2. In other news, the Giants placed Matt Chapman on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Kris Bubic, Connor Seabold, Corey Seager, Will Vest, Connelly Early, Anthony Bender, and Jeremy Peña all being placed on the injured list. The Giants' Matt Chapman is out with an abdominal strain, while the Royals' Kris Bubic and Connor Seabold are dealing with left elbow soreness and a right lat strain, respectively.

The Nationals made a significant roster move, acquiring right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas from the Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Giants also made a trade, sending first baseman Buddy Kennedy to the Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Orioles Dominate White Sox in 6-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a decisive win over the Chicago White Sox, with a final score of 6-1. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Rangers Fall to Guardians in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Austin Hedges led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. Kevin McGonigle led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Matt Chapman on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The move was made on July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
